Definition: from the same as G2774; (specially) to strike on the head:--wound in the head.
BiblicalUsage: Kephalaioo means to wound in the head. Mark 12:4 says the husbandmen cast stones at the servant, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wounded servant is every prophet before him, and the son they would kill next.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants
